tools.name: find_laws
tools.description: Search or filter the Laws of Software Engineering corpus (56 laws). Provide a text query to match titles and descriptions, a category to filter by group, or both. Returns a list of matching laws with their slug, title, description, category, and URLs to HTML and markdown versions.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match against law title and description (e.g., "organization", "estimate", "complexity").

tools.name: get_law
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific law by its slug (e.g., "conways-law", "brooks-law", "yagni"). Returns structured data including definition, takeaways, overview, examples, origins, related laws, and further reading. Use find_laws first if you do not know the slug.

slug.description: Law slug: lowercase, hyphen-separated, no apostrophes (e.g., "conways-law" not "conway's-law").
